scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w client && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o bin/server ./server/cmd/server
scripts.test: vitest run && go vet ./... && go test ./...
scripts.dev:server: go build -o bin/server ./server/cmd/server && cd server && PORT=3000 MAGICKA_DEV=1 exec ../bin/server
